title: ApprovalRequestedData
description: data of approval.requested (PRD 9.5). A proposed side effect waits at a gate for a person. outbox_id is reserved for the outbox entry the gate releases, and item pins the draft or file the gate holds to its version (null when there is none); the entry's item and the gate card's gate.action.item equal it (card rule CR-12, outbox rule OB-05). Nothing is written to the outbox before the gate opens, and this event never authorises (authz null): only an approval.resolved answering approve on the same gate does (OB-01).
